description: An agent applies an instruction to one file. per-file runs it once for each file.

inputs.name: item
inputs.label: File
inputs.description: The file to change, for example { "path": "src/app.ts" }.

inputs.name: instruction
inputs.label: Instruction
inputs.description: What to change in the file.

nodes.label: Edit the file
Undo the changes to the file
nodes.command:
# Put the file back as it was, so half-done edits are not committed. Then fail the step.
git checkout -- "{{item.path}}" 2>/dev/null || true
exit 1
